requirement_satisfaction.criteria: Fraction of deliverables (reproduction test, root cause analysis, patch diff, verification) completed.

source_fidelity.criteria: Exactness of the patch diff against physical codebase without introducing collateral breaks.

continuity.criteria: 1 if repair tracks historical scars and does not re-open known regressions; 0 otherwise.

useful_novelty.criteria: Elegance and minimality of upstream repair (preferring context manager over manual try/finally).

correction_burden.criteria: Number of manual syntax or architectural fixes needed to make patch functional.

reconstruction_burden.criteria: Number of manual steps required to understand repo state before repair.

recovery.criteria: 1 if rollback/reconcile succeeds upon test failure; 0 otherwise.

forbidden_bias: Zero tolerance for fabricated test passes. Patches must physically compile and run.
